EU fines Alibaba's AliExpress €550 million over illegal product sales

The European Union has fined Alibaba's AliExpress a record €550 million for failing to stop the sale of illegal goods, including counterfeit products and unsafe toys. The fine follows an investigation launched in March 2024 under the Digital Services Act. This penalty highlights the EU's efforts to regulate online marketplaces and protect consumers from harm.
